## Humanizer Report

**Average Score Before:** 2.4/10
**Average Score After:** 7.6/10
**Posts Needing Rewrites:** 3/3 (100%)

### Common AI Patterns Detected and Fixed

| Pattern | Frequency | Fix Applied |
|---------|-----------|-------------|
| Throat-Clear Opening (#1) | 3/3 posts | Replaced with lead-with-the-point openings |
| Placeholder Links (#22) | 3/3 posts (15+ instances) | All removed — sentences rewritten to stand alone |
| Actionable Takeaway Boxes (#23) | 2/3 posts | Deleted — actions woven into paragraph flow |
| Identical Paragraph Shape (#14) | 3/3 posts | Varied paragraph length (1-sentence to 5-sentence) |
| Comprehensive Treatment (#15) | 3/3 posts | Cut weakest 30% of points, doubled down on strongest |
| Diplomatic Tone (#16) | 3/3 posts | Added clear opinions and authoritative positions |
| Adverb Stack (#9) | 3/3 posts | "Significantly," "dramatically," "fundamentally" removed |
| Abstract Nouns (#10) | 2/3 posts | "Leverage" → "use," "utilize" → "run" |
| Hedge Cluster (#11) | 2/3 posts | "It's worth noting" → just state it |
| Meta-Description Voice Bleed (#24) | 3/3 posts | Rewrote meta in TLDR voice — no "discover" or "unlock" |
| 2x Bloat Ratio (#25) | 3/3 posts | Average 37% word reduction across all posts |

### TLDR Voice Improvements Applied
- Added TLDR proof points: 48% open rates, 7M+ subscribers, 12 newsletters
- Referenced case studies: Delve (52x ROI), Redact (50% lower CPC)
- Matched voice sample rhythm: short sentences, paragraph variety, lead with interesting thing
- Removed all corporate hedging — replaced with authoritative positions
